briefing.text:
## Who and why
- Sam Okafor, security architect, reviewing Beacon before a pilot (call brief, 9 Nov)
## Deals
- Pilot, 60k, stage Discover (opportunity: Gateway pilot)

transcript.speaker: Sam Okafor
transcript.text: Sure. My main questions are about certificates.

transcript.speaker: Sam Okafor
transcript.text: How often does Beacon rotate the mutual TLS certificates?

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Good question, let me pull that up.

transcript.speaker: Sam Okafor
transcript.text: We need rotation at least daily for our auditors.

transcript.speaker: Sam Okafor
transcript.text: Second topic is rate limits under burst traffic.

transcript.speaker: Sam Okafor
transcript.text: Our parcel scanners send everything at shift change.

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Have other logistics teams seen the same pattern?

transcript.speaker: Sam Okafor
transcript.text: I would love to know how they handled it.

transcript.speaker: Sam Okafor
transcript.text: Also, do you log every denied request?

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: Yes, denied requests go to the access log.

transcript.speaker: Sam Okafor
transcript.text: Good. What about the admin port?

transcript.speaker: Me
transcript.text: It binds to localhost by default.

toolCalls.result: Beacon rotates mTLS certificates every 24 hours by default; set rotation.interval to change it. (product docs: Certificate rotation, https://docs.example.com/beacon/mtls)
